notas.n01: Decision: migrate authentication to OAuth2 with PKCE for the mobile app. Reason: refresh tokens in the browser were leaking through logs.
notas.n02: Fix: the nightly backup job failed because the disk was full; added a retention policy of seven days and an alert at 80 percent usage.
notas.n03: Procedure: rotate the database credentials every ninety days using the secrets manager, then restart the workers one at a time.
notas.n04: Research: comparison of three vector databases for semantic search; chose SQLite with exact search because the corpus has under fifty thousand chunks.
notas.n05: Meeting: sprint planning agreed to freeze the release on Thursday and move the payment refactor to the next sprint.
notas.n06: Fix: Windows paths with backslashes broke the file indexer; normalized every path to forward slashes before hashing.
notas.n07: Decision: use feature flags for the new billing page so we can roll back without a deploy.
notas.n08: Tool: shell script that exports the issue tracker to markdown every Friday and files it in the vault.
notas.n09: Incident: the API returned 502 errors for twenty minutes after the load balancer certificate expired; added certificate expiry monitoring.
notas.n10: Reference: coding standards for Python services: type hints required, black formatting, pytest for tests, no wildcard imports.
notas.n11: Decision: adopt trunk-based development with short-lived branches and required code review from one teammate.
notas.n12: Fix: the embedding model was loaded four times, once per client; a single shared daemon now keeps one copy in memory.
notas.n13: Procedure: onboarding checklist for new engineers: laptop setup, repository access, first pull request within the first week.
notas.n14: Research: latency of the speech to text service dropped from nine seconds to two after switching to streaming transcription.
notas.n15: Decision: keep customer data in the European region only to meet the data residency clause in the contract.
notas.n16: Fix: memory leak in the image resizing worker; the thumbnails buffer was never released after upload.
notas.n17: Meeting: retrospective found that flaky tests wasted about four hours per week; quarantined the five worst tests.
notas.n18: Reference: glossary of billing terms: invoice, credit note, proration, dunning, and write-off.
notas.n19: Tool: command line script that anonymizes a production database dump for use in staging.
notas.n20: Incident: duplicate emails were sent to customers because the queue consumer retried without an idempotency key.
notas.n21: Decision: pick PostgreSQL over MongoDB for the orders service because we need transactions across several tables.
notas.n22: Fix: dark mode contrast failed accessibility checks; raised text contrast to a ratio of 4.5 to 1.
notas.n23: Procedure: how to roll back a bad release: revert the tag, redeploy the previous image, and announce in the incident channel.
notas.n24: Research: user interviews showed customers abandon the signup form at the phone number field.
notas.n25: Decision: sunset the legacy XML API on the first of March and give partners ninety days notice.
notas.n26: Fix: the cron job ran twice after daylight saving time changed; schedule now uses UTC.
notas.n27: Reference: on-call handbook with escalation contacts, severity levels, and the first-response checklist.
notas.n28: Tool: Grafana dashboard that shows error rate, p95 latency and queue depth for every service.
notas.n29: Incident: the search index became corrupted after two processes wrote at the same time; moved to a single writer.
notas.n30: Decision: limit file uploads to twenty megabytes and scan every file for malware before storing.
notas.n31: Meeting: quarterly planning chose reliability work over new features for the next six weeks.
notas.n32: Fix: timezone bug showed meetings one hour early for users in Brazil; store timestamps in UTC and convert on display.
notas.n33: Procedure: monthly cost review of cloud spending: tag every resource, delete unattached volumes, right-size instances.
notas.n34: Research: benchmark of three static site generators; build time was ten times faster with the Rust-based one.
notas.n35: Reference: API rate limits are one hundred requests per minute per token, with a burst of twenty.
notas.n36: Decision: write the mobile app with React Native instead of two native codebases to ship on both platforms.
notas.n37: Fix: password reset links stayed valid forever; they now expire after thirty minutes and work once.
notas.n38: Tool: pre-commit hook that blocks commits containing API keys or private keys.
notas.n39: Incident: a migration locked the users table for eleven minutes; large migrations now run in batches outside business hours.
notas.n40: Meeting: design review approved the new onboarding flow with three steps instead of seven.
